mapper.select: SELECT l.*, p.display_name AS current_product_name, p.normalized_name AS current_product_normalized, p.status='ACTIVE' AS product_active, pc.status='ACTIVE' AS primary_active, sc.status='ACTIVE' AS secondary_active, u.status='ACTIVE' AS unit_active, f.status='ACTIVE' AS funding_active, ch.status='ACTIVE' AS purchase_active, loc.status='ACTIVE' AS location_active, py.status='ACTIVE' AS payer_active, ic.status='ACTIVE' AS income_category_active FROM ledger_entry l LEFT JOIN product p ON p.id=l.product_id LEFT JOIN expense_category pc ON pc.id=l.primary_category_id LEFT JOIN expense_category sc ON sc.id=l.secondary_category_id LEFT JOIN unit u ON u.id=l.unit_id LEFT JOIN funding_channel f ON f.id=l.funding_channel_id LEFT JOIN purchase_channel ch ON ch.id=l.purchase_channel_id LEFT JOIN location_label loc ON loc.id=l.location_label_id LEFT JOIN payer py ON py.id=l.payer_id LEFT JOIN income_category ic ON ic.id=l.income_category_id WHERE l.id=#{p.id} AND l.lifecycle_status='ACTIVE' FOR UPDATE OF l

SELECT id,entry_type,display_name, CASE WHEN entry_type='EXPENSE' THEN paid_amount ELSE income_amount END AS amount, CASE WHEN entry_type='EXPENSE' THEN primary_category_name_snapshot ELSE payer_name_snapshot END AS context_name, last_used_at FROM daily_entry_template WHERE entry_type=#{p.type} ORDER BY last_used_at DESC,id DESC LIMIT 100

SELECT t.*, p.status='ACTIVE' AS product_active, pc.status='ACTIVE' AS primary_active, sc.status='ACTIVE' AS secondary_active, u.status='ACTIVE' AS unit_active, f.status='ACTIVE' AS funding_active, ch.status='ACTIVE' AS purchase_active, loc.status='ACTIVE' AS location_active, py.status='ACTIVE' AS payer_active, ic.status='ACTIVE' AS income_category_active FROM daily_entry_template t LEFT JOIN product p ON p.id=t.product_id LEFT JOIN expense_category pc ON pc.id=t.primary_category_id LEFT JOIN expense_category sc ON sc.id=t.secondary_category_id LEFT JOIN unit u ON u.id=t.unit_id LEFT JOIN funding_channel f ON f.id=t.funding_channel_id LEFT JOIN purchase_channel ch ON ch.id=t.purchase_channel_id LEFT JOIN location_label loc ON loc.id=t.location_label_id LEFT JOIN payer py ON py.id=t.payer_id LEFT JOIN income_category ic ON ic.id=t.income_category_id WHERE t.id=#{p.id} FOR UPDATE OF t
